Red Hat Certifications and Red Hat Partner OPEN courses

Posted on 2020-12-19 | In Training

IBMers are able to pursue full Red Hat Certifications by purchasing a Red Hat Learning Subscription Standard for $1000/person/year (this is chargeable to your department or to your funding IBM entity).

Red Hat Learning Subscription(RHLS for short) Standard Overview

  • Subscription fee ($1,000+) per person (Volume)
  • Valid for one year (365 days)
  • Access to ~100 courses & exams on technologies and products*
  • Access to 52 courses on technologies and products
  • Access to 14 development courses
  • Access to 32 certification exams
  • Covers 5 certification exams per person, per year
  • Covers 2 certification exam retakes per person per year
  • Access to hands-on labs (400+ Hours)

Certification Exams example

Code Certifications
EX200 Red Hat Certified System Administrator
EX294 Red Hat Certified Engineer
EX280 Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration
EX288 Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Application Development

How to start after subscribing the RHLS

  • Go to https://rol.redhat.com/rol/app/ with your Red Hat Network ID
  • Click ‘Enroll’ under MY SKILLS PATHS to choose your skill path (e.g. Red Hat Certified Engineer or Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration), then enroll it.
  • Now you can start to study the relevant courses by video classroom or online training.

FREE Red Hat Online Courses

Red Hat offers offers free training to partners through OPEN (Online Partner Enablement Network)

  • Self-paced learning courses leading to accreditations
  • Accreditation: Valid for 2 years at the current place of employment
  1. To access OPEN, create a Red Hat Account
    • Go to partner page https://www.redhat.com/en/partners/Homepage
    • Select “Join an existing partner company”
    • Select REGISTER for a REDHAT.COM Account
    • Create an account with IBM Internet ID (e.g., name@us.ibm.com)
  2. Verify Email – An email verification note will be sent to you
    • Follow the instructions in the note and verify your email address
  3. Back on partner page: https://www.redhat.com/en/partners/Homepage
    • Select “Join an existing partner company”
    • Select “Login to A Redhat.com Account” using credentials from step #1
    • Select partner type “System Integrator”
    • E-mail will be sent to you with link & access to Red Hat OPEN portal
    • OPEN portal URL https://partnercenter.redhat.com/Dashboard_page
